prototype.name: Procedural Geomorphic Simulation
prototype.description: High-fidelity analytical 3D model of Jezero Crater for offline and high-performance client rendering without API keys.

nasa_trek_wmts.name: NASA Solar System Treks WMTS Service
nasa_trek_wmts.description: Real-time Web Map Tile Service stream from NASA JPL Trek API.
nasa_trek_wmts.instructions: No API key required for public Trek tiles. Add layer URL in nasaLayerAdapter.ts.

usgs_pds_geotiff.name: USGS Astrogeology / PDS Geosciences GeoTIFF DEM
usgs_pds_geotiff.description: Raw 32-bit floating point Digital Elevation Models from MGS MOLA and MRO HiRISE.
usgs_pds_geotiff.instructions: Place downloaded GeoTIFF file (.tif) into /public/data/terrain/ and configure loadNASAGeoTIFF() in terrainAdapter.ts.
